name: Dance of Blades

dance_observation.effect_text: A deadly dance that increases your melee damage the longer you perform it.
dance_observation.attribution_text:
Read from the VGO Emulator client. Ranks deepen the longer the dance is held in combat; the level in brackets is when that rank becomes available.
Level 0 - +4% Damage
Level 1 - +6% Damage (gained at level 5)
Level 2 - +8% Damage (gained at level 10)
Level 3 - +10% Damage (gained at level 18)
Level 4 - +14% Damage (gained at level 28)
Level 5 - +20% Damage (gained at level 36)
